decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone, zero tickets. Two Wrenfield nudges (email:163f5ccb, email:a6a2ede7) got no reply, and Mia no-showed the kickoff (calendar:aee3e848) — no sign of self-serve momentum with 8 days left.

draft.subject: Quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Sorry we missed each other for the kickoff last week — happy to work around your schedule.

If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. Starting with something real your team is already working on tends to make it click fastest.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up. Just tell me a time that suits and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Priya
